cases.title: Add single note successfully
cases.description: Clicking the "Add note" button (data-testid="add-note-button") appends a new note <div> with class "note" containing a visible, empty <textarea> (data-testid="note-textarea").

cases.title: Add multiple notes with rapid clicks
cases.description: Performing multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button creates separate notes, each containing its own distinct textarea.

cases.title: Real-time Markdown Rendering and Persistence
cases.description: Verify that typing Markdown content like headings, bold, and italic text into the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") dynamically renders proper HTML formatting in the main display area (data-testid="note-main") in real-time and updates local storage immediately.

cases.title: Invalid Markdown Handling and Mode Exit
cases.description: Verify that invalid Markdown such as unmatched asterisks does not cause crashes or errors, displays raw input, and correctly preserves raw input when exiting edit mode via the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button").

cases.title: Verify note creation enters edit mode and toggles between view and edit modes
cases.description: When a new note is created by clicking the Add note button (data-testid="add-note-button"), it immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") is hidden. Clicking the Edit button (data-testid="edit-note-button") toggles the mode, hiding the textarea and displaying the formatted content in the main content area.

cases.title: Verify automatic saving of note changes to local storage
cases.description: Ensure that all changes typed into the note textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") are automatically saved to local storage, preserving the note's state and content across browser sessions.

cases.title: Delete note removes it from DOM and localStorage
cases.description: Clicking the delete-note-button on a note immediately removes the targeted note from the DOM and removes its corresponding entry from localStorage.

cases.title: Load stored notes with content from localStorage
cases.description: When the Notes App webpage loads with saved notes containing content in localStorage, it retrieves all notes and dynamically creates div elements with class note, showing the main content area (data-testid="note-main") and hiding the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") by default.

cases.title: Load stored notes without content from localStorage
cases.description: When the Notes App webpage loads with saved notes that have no content, the application shows the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") and hides the main content area (data-testid="note-main") for immediate editing.

opinions.feedback: All proposed high-level test cases are well-structured, distinct, highly testable, and completely aligned with the given requirements.
All requirements and cases are fully consistent and verifiable. No blockers detected.

analysis.analysis: Decomposed the requirements into normal, edge, boundary, and abnormal scenarios based on the provided UI identifiers and functionality for notes creation, markdown rendering, view/edit mode toggling, deletion, and local storage persistence.

output.analysis: For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-1: Normal scenario - Click the "Add note" button (id="add", class="add", data-testid="add-note-button") once to append a <div> with class "note" containing a visible, empty <textarea> (data-testid="note-textarea"). Edge scenario - Multiple rapid clicks on the "Add note" button, verifying that each click creates a separate note with its own textarea. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-2: Normal scenario - Type valid Markdown (e.g., # Heading, **bold**, _italic_, [link](...)) in the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") and observe real-time rendering in data-testid="note-main" with proper HTML formatting. Edge scenario - Input invalid Markdown (e.g., unmatched **) to verify it does not crash or cause errors and displays raw input when exiting edit mode. Boundary scenario - Persistence of changes immediately in local storage. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-3: Normal scenario - Verify that upon clicking "Add note", the note immediately enters edit mode where the textarea (data-testid="note-textarea") is visible and the main content area (data-testid="note-main") remains hidden, and clicking the "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button") toggles between edit and view modes. Edge scenario - Automatic saving of all typed changes into local storage to preserve state across sessions. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-4: Normal scenario - Click the "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button") associated with a note to immediately remove the targeted note from the DOM and from localStorage. For requirement e2edev_bench_02-R-5: Normal scenario - Load the webpage with saved notes in localStorage, dynamically creating note divs with tools, "Edit" button (data-testid="edit-note-button"), "Delete" button (data-testid="delete-note-button"), main div (data-testid="note-main"), and textarea (data-testid="note-textarea"), where notes with content display the main div and hide the textarea by default. Edge scenario - Load notes that have no content, showing the textarea and hiding the main div for immediate editing. Additional edge scenario - Load application when localStorage is completely empty or contains no notes, ensuring no notes are shown.

Edge scenarios include loading a note with no content which shows the textarea and hides the main div, and loading the application when localStorage is completely empty resulting in no notes displayed.
